title: AMICS, Microanalysis, X-ray Mapping, and XRD Characterization to Create a REE Concentrate Analysis Workflow
content: Automated Mineralogy (AM or MLA) is a technique which traditionally allows for fast and reliable analysis of ore processing concentrates as well as being used as an exploration tool for Geology. Automated mineralogy during its growth period in the 2000’s has seen applications developed in iron ore [1], bauxite [2], mineral sands [3], laterites [4] and diamonds [5]. There have also been uses away from the traditional applications including meteorites [6] and fly ash cement additives [7].
